faqs.q: Is door-to-door pickup included?
faqs.a: Yes. Door-to-door pickup is included in every lesson at no extra cost. We collect you from home, work, or college across 49 locations in Cork city and county.

faqs.q: What does the pretest lesson include?

faqs.q: Do you offer automatic driving lessons in Cork?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer automatic driving lessons at all package levels. Automatic lessons start from €54.94 per lesson with the 12-lesson package. Single automatic lessons cost €61.41.

Cork is not like Dublin. The roads are different, the test routes are different, and the challenges are specific to this county. The Dunkettle Interchange alone is enough to make experienced drivers think twice, and your instructor will take you through it step by step until it feels routine.

Kinsale Road Roundabout, the South Ring Road at rush hour, merging onto the N40, threading through Western Road near UCC, and the one-way system on Patrick Street. These are real situations you will face in your test and in your daily driving. Our instructors know every lane, every filter light, and every tricky right turn.

Outside the city, learners in Blarney, Ballincollig, and Midleton face their own challenges. Country roads between Bandon and Macroom, the narrow streets through Cobh, the N71 into Skibbereen. Each test centre has its own routes, and we know them all.
If you have questions about lessons in your area, get in touch . We will match you with an instructor who knows your roads.

Each lesson covers a specific skill: car controls, road positioning, roundabouts, motorway driving, night driving, and more. Our 12-lesson package covers the full EDT at the lowest per-lesson rate.
If you hold a foreign licence and are converting to an Irish licence, you may qualify for the reduced 6-lesson programme. Call us on 021 2355558 and we will confirm which applies to you.

A pretest lesson is a one-hour session focused entirely on your driving test. Your instructor drives you through the actual routes used by the tester at your booked test centre. You practise the junctions, roundabouts, and road sections that come up on test day.
The price includes car hire for the test itself . You drive the same dual-controlled car you practised in. No need to arrange a car or find an accompanying driver.
Pretest lessons are for learners who have already completed their EDT or most of it. If you are still in the early stages, a regular lesson package is the better fit.
The driving test follows the same pattern every time. No surprises. Here is how the day goes.
We collect you from home or a meeting point near the test centre. You get a warm-up drive on the test routes to settle your nerves and loosen up.
Park up and head inside. Bring your learner permit, logbook, and glasses if required. The tester will call your name.
The tester asks a few questions about the car. Where is the fog light switch? How do you check the tyre tread? You will have practised all of these.
The tester gives directions. Left here, right at the next junction, follow the road. These are the same routes you drove in your pretest lesson. You know them already.
At some point the tester asks for a turnabout (three-point turn) and a reverse around a corner or into a space. Practise these until they are automatic.
The tester gives you the result straight away. If you pass, you get a Certificate of Competency. If not, you get a detailed fault sheet so you know exactly what to work on.
